hypothesis: Token-to-slot competition, local assignment structure, cross-object and cross-episode negatives, and main-action-gradient supervision will prevent R3's predictive auxiliaries from being solved by a shared collapsed representation and make aligned cross-replan memory causally useful.
objective: Complete 500 finite optimizer steps and save the full checkpoint; keep slot mean absolute off-diagonal cosine below 0.95; make positive temporal similarity exceed both cross-object and cross-episode negative similarity by at least 0.05; retain active finite action-gradient supervision; and make aligned-history held-out main action loss at least 1 percent lower than both zero-history and batch-shuffled-history interventions. Do not launch 20k unless every gate passes.

config.overrides: R3 fixed-scale 0.25 memory cross-attention plus FiLM after every action layer; eight competitive object slots; diversity 0.20; assignment entropy, usage balance, and spatial compactness 0.05 each; temporal correspondence 0.02; cross-object and cross-episode contrastive 0.10 each at temperature 0.07; local action-gradient alignment 0.05; memory-only future-action auxiliary 0.25; B4 warm start; train strong_action_expert; 500 steps; batch 64 per rank; DP8; accumulation 1; maximum 8 validation batches

data.version: RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus Wan latent cache and visual-history sidecar
data.revision: 1,143,698 fixed records; 280 shards; same-physical-episode t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history lookup; scalar episode ID used only to exclude false negatives and form detached cross-rank negative prototypes; no future or cross-episode lookup

command: launch_b5_vom_probe_r4_8gpu.sh followed by launch_b5_vom_matched_val_r4.sh none, zero, and shuffle; formal 20k remained blocked because the main-action causal-use gates failed.
hardware: pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; global batch 512

preflight.focused_tests: 22 passed in the production container: 13 strong-action-expert tests and 9 action-config tests
preflight.gpu_smoke: Two-rank NCCL B200 BF16 production-dimension forward/backward finite with loss 2.0586414 and peak allocation 907.19 MiB per rank; cross-episode negative fraction 1.0; action-gradient valid fraction 1.0; all six required parameter groups received finite nonzero gradients
preflight.import_path_guard: Formal source imported the new action-gradient function from the immutable R4 path before launch

validation.legacy_validator: The bundled validator still requires SHA-256 fields and is superseded by the workflow's higher-priority no-hash policy; immutable non-hash fields were compared with the prelaunch manifest using jq.
validation.checked_fields: Prelaunch immutable fields, exact formal source, start and completion timestamps, four run IDs, exit states, W&B terminal metrics, step-500 gradient evidence, checkpoint components, and GPU monitor summary

conclusion: Object-local competition, diversity, cross-object and cross-episode negatives, and local action-gradient supervision prevented the R3 shared-slot collapse and learned highly separated temporally matched object slots. The memory-only action decoder used aligned memory, but the full ActionDiT main path still did not benefit from correct memory over zero or shuffled memory. Representation identifiability improved; causal policy use did not.
failure_reason: Aligned main action loss was 0.04132 percent worse than zero and 0.00946 percent worse than shuffle, rather than at least 1 percent better. The formal 20k run was not launched even though all anti-collapse, contrastive-margin, finite-gradient, and checkpoint gates passed.
